prompt: Built-in imagegen: square 3x3 swatch of crude prehistoric finds on warm ivory paper, matte gouache and dry brush. Cells in order: soot leaf print, loose root nest, handstone and soft anvil, quick-release plant-fiber knot, charcoal shadow smudge, shell repaired with chip, wood curl and tinder, ochre thumbprint on stone tool, shell scraping raw hide.

entries.review: Top-left: blackened leaf-shaped soot impression on rough stone with crumbled leaf beside it.
Top-middle: loose tangled roots forming a shallow open nest, with visible free ends rather than finished basket sides.
Top-right: hard rounded handstone on a softer battered earth-and-clay anvil with irregular impact scars.
Middle-left: frayed plant-fiber loop and knot with one long free pull end.
Middle-middle: amorphous charcoal smudge following a rough natural rock contour, with no legible symbols.
Middle-right: large broken shell with a jagged stone chip lodged awkwardly at its rim.
Bottom-left: thin curled raw wood shaving beside black tinder crumbs, no carved ornament.
Bottom-middle: plain chipped handstone bearing a single uneven red ochre grip smear.
Bottom-right: natural shell edge against rough untanned hide with a newly scraped pale patch.
